test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the 'In Vitro Fertilization (IVF)' method, babies are born by which of the following processes?

options.text: Internal fertilization of sperm and egg and external development of embryo
Development of the fetus inside a test tube
Development of a fetus from a single parent
External fertilization of sperm and egg

solution:
The correct answer is __**External fertilization of sperm and egg**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the 'In Vitro Fertilization (IVF)' method, babies are born by external fertilization of sperm and egg.**
 
• IVF is a process of fertilization where an egg is combined with sperm outside the body, in vitro ("in glass").
 
• The process involves monitoring and stimulating a woman's ovulatory process, removing an ovum or ova (egg or eggs) from her ovaries, and letting sperm fertilize them in a laboratory environment.
 
• The fertilized egg (zygote) undergoes embryo culture for 2–6 days and is then transferred to the same or another woman's uterus, with the intention of establishing a successful pregnancy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• IVF is a major treatment for infertility when other methods of assisted reproductive technology have failed.
 
• The success rate of IVF varies and depends on various factors, including maternal age, cause of infertility, and the quality of the embryo.
 
• IVF can also be used to prevent genetic problems and assist with the conception of a child.
 
• IVF has led to the birth of millions of babies worldwide since its inception.
